name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Pineapple
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Pineapple Live Resin Gummies offer an island-inspired flavor backed by a full-spectrum cannabis experience. Each gummy contains 20MG of live resin for effects that are as smooth and sunny as the taste.

With a bright pineapple profile and dependable texture, this gummy is perfect for easy escapes.

Whether you’re beach-bound or couch-locked—this gummy brings the warmth.
